name: B10-0345/2025 (ECR) – Urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the June 22 terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus, which killed over 25 worshippers, and other violence against Christians, Alawites and Druze. It calls on Syria's caretaker authorities to stop violent factions, investigate all killings fairly, and protect religious minorities and their places of worship. It also asks the EU to keep and add sanctions on those responsible, and to tie lifting sanctions to better religious freedom. This is the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- Parliament condemns the church attack and violence against Christians, Alawites and Druze.
- Syria's caretaker authorities are urged to investigate killings and protect minorities.
- The EU is asked to link lifting sanctions to improved religious freedom.
